summary: Amber International Holding Ltd, a Singapore-domiciled crypto-asset finance services issuer formerly iClick Interactive, filed a routine Form 6-K covering the interim period ended June 30, 2026. The submission contains XBRL-tagged IFRS interim financial information, segment disclosures across digital-asset services, payments and execution solutions, geographic splits, and fair-value hierarchy detail on Level 3 fund and equity investments. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. No deal terms are stated. This is an ordinary periodic foreign-private-issuer report; no risk-arbitrage angle applies.
